card.name: Passive verbs in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The word BE (or TO) right after SHOULD NOT, MUST or SHOULD in all-caps label warnings, where a passive verb such as allowed, administered, diluted or monitored comes next.

modes.label: BE after modal
modes.description: The word BE after SHOULD NOT, MUST or SHOULD in capitalized instructions.
modes.example: MITOXANTRONE SHOULD NOT<< BE>> ADMINISTERED SUBCUTANEO

modes.label: Other all-caps links
modes.description: Other linking words in all-caps text that lead into a verb, such as TO or the start of SWALLOWED.
modes.example: CAPSULES ARE TO BE<< SW>>ALLOWED WHOLE OR THE ENTIRE

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word allow and its forms, such as allowed, allowing and allows.
card.plain: It fires on the word "be" in capitalized label warnings like "must be diluted" or "should not be allowed", just before the action verb.
